meta.title: Your business online in one month — €100
meta.description: A professional site, Google and reviews for your business. In one month you're online — that part is guaranteed. Then you decide each month, and at €900 the site is yours forever.

formula.titleBefore: Your business online in one month.
formula.subtitle: In one month your business is online and people find you on Google: that part is guaranteed. Every month I show you the real numbers and you decide whether to carry on. At €900, the site is yours.

how.title: In one month you're online. Then you decide, every month.

s1.title: Month 1 — €100, you're online
s1.description: We put everything live: site, domain, Google listing, local SEO and QR reviews. That happens for certain — it is not a gamble.

s2.title: Every month you decide
s2.description: €100 a month, no lock-in. Every month you get the real numbers — visits, calls, reviews — and you decide with them in front of you. Stop whenever you like, no penalties.

s3.title: At €900 the site is yours
s3.description: Nine months at €100 — or settle the balance whenever you want. Domain, site and code transfer to you. Forever.

s4.title: After: €30/month, if you want
s4.description: Menus, prices, photos and news kept fresh by us. Optional: the site stays yours either way.

custom.title: Custom projects

modules.title: The showcase is only the beginning.
modules.subtitle: Once the site is working, we can add pieces that work with it. Each one is agreed separately, when you need it — never before.

agent.title: An AI that answers the phone
agent.description: Staff busy and the phone ringing unanswered? A voice assistant picks up like a person, takes orders and bookings, and hands them to you already written down.

whatsapp.title: Automated WhatsApp Business
whatsapp.description: Instant replies, booking confirmations, reminders and follow-ups: the number your customers already use, without holding it all day.

flows.title: Custom automations
flows.description: Invoices, CRM, follow-up emails, spreadsheets and tools wired together: repetitive work disappears from your day.

apps.title: Mobile apps
apps.description: Delivery, gym memberships, loyalty: when the business grows, the app comes from the same studio that built your site.

proof.title: The Formula already has its first client.
proof.subtitle: Aulon Detailing joined through the Formula and is live on its own domain, from the United States. Nonsolofitness trusted us with their site and is live in Torvaianica. And for many local businesses the site is already built, waiting for their go-ahead.

stop.q: What if I don't want to continue in month two?
stop.a: You stop paying. No penalty, no lock-in. The site goes offline and you only spent the months you used.

own.q: Who owns the site while I'm paying?
own.a: Until you reach €900 it stays with Fentriq — that's why trying it costs so little. Once you complete €900, domain, site and code become 100% yours.

fast.q: Can I close early and pay it all?
fast.a: Yes, anytime: settle the balance up to €900 and the site is yours from that moment.

report.q: How do I know it's working?
report.a: Every month you get a simple report on WhatsApp: how many people saw the site, how many called or booked, how your Google listing is doing. Numbers, not promises.

after.a: Run it yourself, or for €30 a month we keep it fresh: menus, prices, photos, news. No obligation.

cost.q: How much does a project cost?
cost.a: For local businesses there's the Formula: first month at €100 all-in, then €100/month with no lock-in — at €900 the site is yours. For custom projects, a clear fixed quote after a free call.

time.a: An MVP or a site in 1–3 weeks; larger projects in stages.

where.q: Do you only work in Rome?
where.a: We work with SMEs across Italy, remotely. In person in Rome, Milan and Florence.

scope.a: No: web, apps, AI, Web3 and automation. Full-stack.
